articles.title: Putin-Xi Meeting Unlikely to Bring Substantive Results for Trump, Says Jane Harman
articles.description: Jane Harman, a former ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, talked about the potential national security risks from the Nvidia scandal, Trump’s upcoming meetings in Asia and the Senate Democratic leadership battle. Harman said that potential meetings between President Trump, Xi Jinping and Putin in China are unlikely to provide any substantive results other than a 'good photo op.' On the fight for Senate leadership between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen, Harman said that no matter the leader, Democrats should take seriously voters' calls for change. (Source: Bloomberg)
